messages.subject: stat_density2d with weights
parts:
Hi all ggplot2 experts,


I'm doing some stat_density2d() plots with weighted data. What I found out is, that the graphic doesn't change if I am adding a 'weight' variable (as shown in the example)- there is no warning or error, but no change. A toy example/simplification of my 'real problem':


library(ggplot2)
set.seed(17122012)
a <- c(runif(6,0,1), runif(3,2,4))
b <- c(runif(6,0,1), runif(3,2,5))
weights <- rep(c(1.354,20),c(6.045474,3))

df1 <- data.frame(a,b,WEI=weights)

p1 <- ggplot(df1,aes(a,b))
p1 + stat_density2d()

p2 <- ggplot(df1,aes(a,b,weight=WEI))
p2 + stat_density2d()
# they are both the same!


I found out that stat_density2d uses the "kde2d" function which does not permit weights. So, can anybody think of a solution for my problem?
Thank you all!

Manuel
